mathematics.assertion_tested: Derive current, density and pressure from the exact homogeneous +gamma X Box(chi) action with arbitrary lapse; check total P/W/V off-shell balance and flat 1+1 current/stress Ward specialization.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy symbolic expressions over real smooth functions
mathematics.conventions: Signature -+++; X=-grad(chi)^2; gamma constant; E_chi=-div(J); increasing homogeneous tau; final dots are proper-time derivatives
inputs: Arbitrary smooth P(X,tau), W(0,tau), V(tau), a(t), N(t), chi(t), tau(t); arbitrary chi(t,x) in flat 1+1
non_claims: Not a global nonlinear Dirac closure, Legendre regularity or stability proof
No MOND, PPN or empirical certificate
The flat Ward specialization is not the full curved covariant derivation
